notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Ajani's Pridemate triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.
